provenance.note: Real spoken audio synthesized once on macOS TTS (say), converted to the canonical 16 kHz mono PCM s16 WAV the WhisperX service measures. Never regenerated by tests; committed bytes are the fixture.
provenance.zh: say -v Tingting (or Eddy zh_CN fallback); ffmpeg -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a pcm_s16le

speech-en.wav.spokenText: Grassland brings the meadow to every screen. Join us this season.
speech-en.wav.expectation: A real transcription must return English words whose times stay inside this duration; silence must return an explicit empty result, never fabricated cues.

speech-zh.wav.spokenText: 草场把牧场带到每一块屏幕，这一季与我们同行。
speech-zh.wav.expectation: A real transcription must return Chinese characters (not forced 'en'); language comes from the request/analysis, never hard-coded.

silence.wav.note: Generated by tests with ffmpeg anullsrc; speech tools must return {language, segments: []} with no manufactured words.

alignmentEvidence.note: Hand-authored word evidence aligned to the spoken text above, so semantic alignment tests run deterministically offline. The real-transcription tests compare against live WhisperX output instead and are gated on prepared models (EXTERNAL_BLOCKED otherwise).
